$comment: Machine-readable project state. The human-readable companion is MEMORY.md; keep the two in agreement. Validated by scripts/check-memory-freshness.sh in CI.
next_task: Session 6 closed nearly every P0/P1/P2 finding from the session 5 enterprise-readiness audit. Session 7 closed the last 'built but not wired' item: semantic caching, plus a new third (durable, encrypted) cache tier bundled with it -- see docs/adr/0008-tiered-durable-cache.md. Same session, continued: built cache::onnx_embed::OnnxEmbedder (local ONNX embeddings via ort+tokenizers, target model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 -- compared against NVIDIA's open embedding line (Nemotron 3 Embed) and ruled that out on size/architecture fit, not license) behind an off-by-default 'local-embeddings' Cargo feature -- type-checks and passes clippy against the real crate APIs, but has never linked or run (needs a real ONNX Runtime binary + the model file, neither of which this environment has and shouldn't silently fetch) -- see docs/adr/0009-local-onnx-embeddings.md and docs/runbooks/local-embeddings-setup.md. Provisioning that and running the false-positive-rate check against the 0.95 threshold is now the top Next Steps item. Everything else remaining is infrastructure verification: Docker/Redis/Postgres/Qdrant still unconfirmed on this machine, real provider keys for a live end-to-end completion, the k6 load test, the restore drill, 9 remaining UNVERIFIED pricing rows. Full detail: MEMORY.md 'Next Steps'.

audit.method: direct code tracing + 4 parallel focused investigations + adversarial tests actually executed, not documentation review
audit.scorecard_overall: 4/10 at time of audit -- session 6 closed nearly every P0/P1/P2 finding; scorecard not yet re-run/re-published as of this state.json update, see MEMORY.md Current Focus

phases.name: Foundation
phases.evidence: Workspace, full schema migrations with monthly partitioning, typed config, CI, health endpoints verified against a running gateway, ADRs 001-007 (007 added session 5, Vertex AI JWT signing). Migration 0003 added session 6: budgets.region + constraints, model_pricing cache/long-context columns, usage_records cache-token columns.

phases.name: Auth, keys, orgs
phases.evidence: argon2id auth, sessions, API key CRUD with LRU+Redis+PG tiers, audit log, org/member management, dashboard signup/login/keys pages. Session 6: TOTP two-factor now fully enforced end to end (enroll/confirm/disable + login-time check). Note on API-key read scope: management.rs's Part 6 doc comment and MASTER_BUILD.md's own API spec both state the management API is 'session or API-key auth, org-scoped' by design -- API keys reading org-scoped management data (never cross-tenant) is the documented design, not an unscoped defect. Left as-is; re-scoping to a narrower per-key permission model would be a deliberate product change requiring an ADR, not a bug fix.

phases.name: Core gateway
phases.evidence: Ten provider adapters, full twelve-stage pipeline, rate limiting (proven atomic), budgets, BYOK, shared key pool, usage worker, Prometheus metrics, Grafana + 8 new alerting rules. Session 5 fixed SSRF + metering-completeness. Session 6: budget checking is now also atomic under concurrency (reserve-then-true-up, see fixed_this_session), every provider call carries a real Idempotency-Key, and a severe pre-existing routing bug (embedding models winning simple-chat routing decisions on price alone) was found and fixed.
remaining: 9 pricing rows remain UNVERIFIED against provider pricing pages (unchanged from session 5 -- not attempted session 6, needs docs/runbooks/pricing-update.md work, not code).

phases.name: Optimization engine
phases.evidence: Classifier 98% on 100 labelled fixtures, router with graded provider health + bandit-informed selection + human-readable routing explanations (session 6), exact cache, compressor, fallback chain populated with real cross-provider alternates and streaming resilience (session 6). Session 7: semantic cache wired into the live pipeline behind a new cache::embed::Embedder trait (Pro/Enterprise only, embedding on Aegis's own pooled key), plus a new third durable/encrypted cache tier not in the original MASTER_BUILD.md spec -- see docs/adr/0008-tiered-durable-cache.md. verify-phase.sh 3 passes.

phases.name: Dashboards, billing, launch prep
phases.evidence: Stripe webhook verification, invoice assembly, budget enforcement (now atomic, see phase 2), admin console, landing page, docs, savings CSV export, runbooks, Prometheus alert rules (infra/prometheus/alerts.yml, session 6). Session 6: budget threshold alerts (50/80/100%) now actually deliver -- workers/budget_alerts.rs::run is spawned from main.rs with a real sweep + watermark, not just implemented and tested in isolation.
remaining: P4.8 EXECUTE infra/loadtest/k6-gateway.js against a deployed instance (1k RPS over a real network + database) -- still not attempted, needs a live host this machine does not have.

phases.name: Launch + provider expansion
phases.evidence: All providers tested, including Vertex AI (session 5, still not verified against a real GCP project -- no service account key supplied). Classifier v2 trained. Status page. Weekly digest. Referral program. CHANGELOG.md.

phases.name: Enterprise readiness
phases.evidence: Offline license validation, SCIM 2.0 shapes for Okta and Entra, per-tenant HKDF keys (plus a new disjoint per-user HKDF namespace for TOTP secrets, session 6), region pinning enforcement wired (session 3). Session 6 closed four real gaps: (1) SSO can now functionally complete -- OIDC discovery, JWKS fetch/verify, and the previously-unregistered /api/auth/sso/callback route all added; SAML explicitly out of scope with a clear error rather than a rushed implementation. (2) TOTP fully enforced end to end. (3) SCIM tokens are now self-service-mintable via /api/scim-tokens, not just a direct DB write. (4) the admin audit-log endpoint was scoped to the calling admin's own org (useless for a staff member investigating a customer) -- now takes an org_id query parameter; and a customer-facing GET /api/audit-log.jsonl export was added where none existed despite the compliance whitepaper describing one.
remaining: Verify SSO/SCIM against a real Okta or Entra tenant -- never done, only shape- and flow-tested against static fixtures.
SAML support -- deliberately out of scope; the callback returns a clear 'not yet supported' error for a SAML-configured connection rather than a wrong implementation.

phases.name: Scale + moat
phases.evidence: UCB1 outcome bandit. Session 6: the router now actually reads the bandit back to inform routing decisions (RoutingInputs::bandit, folded into select_at_tier's scoring) -- previously write-only. TypeScript and Python SDKs. Regional budgets. Nightly pricing-drift job. Spend anomaly detection. Cost-center chargeback. Investor pack.
remaining: A connection-pooling proxy (PgBouncer or equivalent) or a larger reference instance class is needed before scaling meaningfully past ~10 replicas -- the Postgres connection-pool math finding from session 5, not attempted session 6 (infrastructure sizing, not application code).

blockers.impact: Nothing has been verified against live Postgres, Redis, or Qdrant end to end. Integration tests compile and skip locally; CI runs them against service containers.
blockers.workaround: Reinstall Docker Desktop from scratch and confirm with `docker version` (not a directory listing) before assuming it works. Session 6 added tests/redis_concurrency.rs which DOES exercise real Redis atomicity when AEGIS_TEST_REDIS_URL is set (CI sets it; this machine still does not).

blockers.summary: No real provider API key has been supplied for any provider, including Vertex AI (needs a GCP service-account JSON key, not an API key).
blockers.impact: The pipeline is verified against a mock provider only. TTFT, tokens/sec, and any real cross-provider performance comparison remain entirely unmeasured.
blockers.workaround: Add one key (Gemini) and one GCP service account (Vertex) and send a single request each.

blockers.summary: New, session 6. `gh auth status` reports 'The token in default is invalid.' PR creation via `gh pr create` fails.
blockers.impact: Cannot open a PR from this environment; all session 6 work went directly to origin/main by necessity (consistent with the established pattern from earlier sessions -- the user has not objected to direct-to-main pushes).

Every fix this session (budget atomicity, fallback chain, SSO, TOTP, etc.) is proven by tests written in the same session that made the fix -- real tests, run and passing, but not yet exercised against live infrastructure or reviewed by anyone outside this agent.

fixed_this_session.summary: Reserve-then-true-up atomic budget enforcement (middleware/budget.rs::check_and_reserve, Reservation type). Proven against MemoryStore (concurrent_requests_cannot_overshoot_a_hard_budget) and real Redis (tests/redis_concurrency.rs::budget_reservation_is_atomic_against_real_redis).
alternates_for() computes real cross-provider fallback candidates from the pricing table at openai_compat.rs's call site, replacing the hardcoded &[].
open_stream_with_fallback gives streaming the same retry/fallback path and health recording (record_success_with_latency/record_failure) non-streaming already had.
TimeoutLayer::with_status_code(REQUEST_TIMEOUT, deadline) added to the router; AEGIS_REQUEST_DEADLINE_SECS config, default 180s, mapped to 504.

TokenUsage gained cached_input_tokens/cache_write_tokens; each provider adapter's parse_usage() normalizes that provider's cache-token convention (Anthropic additive, OpenAI/Google subtractive); ModelPricing gained CachePricing rates.
ModelPricing gained an optional LongContextTier (threshold + separate rates); Gemini 2.5 Pro's 200K-token tier is now modeled instead of flattened to the base rate.

Found mid-session, not in the original audit. Requirements::default() now has chat: true, so an embedding model (cheapest price, no tools/vision required) can no longer win a simple chat request purely on price. Proven by a_chat_request_is_never_routed_to_an_embedding_model.

fallback.rs's BreakerEntry gained a rolling success-rate/EWMA-latency HealthScore, replacing the binary circuit-breaker-only signal; feeds price_penalty()/is_degraded() into routing selection directly.
RoutingInputs::bandit threaded through to select_at_tier, which folds established bandit arms into candidate scoring -- previously write-only.
OIDC discovery, JWKS fetch/verify, and /api/auth/sso/callback (previously unregistered) all added. SAML explicitly rejected with a clear error, not attempted.
Repo layer, enrollment/confirm/disable endpoints, login-time AegisError::TotpRequired check, and a new derive_user_key HKDF namespace all added.
Provider::chat/chat_stream trait gained idempotency_key: Option<&str>; generated once per fallback-chain attempt, reused across that attempt's internal retries only, across all 10 providers.
telemetry.rs gained PEM-block and private_key JSON-field redaction patterns for Vertex service-account keys.
workers::scheduler gained is_session_purge_window() (04:00 UTC) and purge_expired_sessions(), wired into run().
reconciliation::run, budget_alerts::run, and a new health_probe::run are all spawned from main.rs now.
infra/prometheus/alerts.yml added -- 8 rules across 4 groups, validated via js-yaml.
tests/redis_concurrency.rs added -- 4 tests against real Redis (rate limiter, budget reservation, refused-reservation-leaves-counter-untouched, scheduler claim), gated on AEGIS_TEST_REDIS_URL.
POST/GET /api/scim-tokens and DELETE /api/scim-tokens/{id} added; previously mintable only by a direct database write.

Removed the rsa dev-dependency (replaced with static PEM test fixtures), upgraded lru 0.12->0.18 (real unsoundness advisory, pop() confirmed called), added a scoped documented ignore in .cargo/audit.toml for the one remaining phantom sqlx-mysql/rsa lockfile entry (confirmed zero active build-graph edges via cargo tree).

GET /api/admin/audit now takes an org_id query parameter (defaults to caller's own org); previously always read the calling admin's own org, which is almost never the customer org a support investigation needs.
GET /api/audit-log.jsonl added -- require_reader-gated, JSONL output -- where no customer-facing audit export existed at all despite the compliance whitepaper describing one.

fixed_session_7.summary: cache/semantic.rs was fully built since session 1 and never called from the live pipeline (flagged by session 3's and session 5's audits, deliberately deferred as a product decision). Wired into routes/openai_compat.rs::execute_with_headroom behind a new cache::embed::Embedder trait (embedding on Aegis's own pooled provider credential, never a customer's BYOK key), gated to Pro/Enterprise plans. A semantic hit also promotes its own wording into the exact-match tier.

New, beyond the original audit scope -- the founder asked directly for a way to keep cost savings from caching without keeping content around indefinitely. Added cache::durable::DurableCache: a fingerprint the hot Redis tier has already proven repeats gets promoted to an encrypted Postgres row (AES-256-GCM, per-tenant HKDF key, same shape as provider_credentials), sliding 30-day TTL, purged on the existing 04:00 UTC scheduler window. See docs/adr/0008-tiered-durable-cache.md.

experimental_unverified.summary: cache::onnx_embed::OnnxEmbedder (ort + tokenizers, target model BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, FP32, mean-pooled + L2-normalized), a second Embedder implementation for a local, sub-2ms-target embedding path replacing ProviderEmbedder's 50-300ms remote call. Model chosen after comparing against the originally-proposed all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and against NVIDIA's open embedding line (Nemotron 3 Embed) -- NVIDIA ruled out on size/architecture fit (smallest variant 1.14B params, GPU-quantized), not license (OpenMDW-1.1 is actually commercial-friendly). Behind an off-by-default 'local-embeddings' Cargo feature specifically so it never affects the default build.
experimental_unverified.verified: cargo check --features local-embeddings succeeds (type-checks against the real ort v2.0.0-rc.10 / tokenizers v0.23 APIs, one real borrow-checker bug caught and fixed). cargo clippy --features local-embeddings --lib is clean. Default (no-flag) cargo build/test confirmed unaffected before and after -- still 774 lib / 814 full-suite.
experimental_unverified.not_verified: cargo build/cargo test WITH the feature fail to link -- confirmed directly (ort-sys emits a self-explanatory placeholder linker input when no ONNX Runtime binary is configured). This means even the pure mean-pooling/normalization unit tests, which need no model at all, have never actually run -- only been reviewed by hand. No real ONNX Runtime binary or bge-small-en-v1.5 model file exists in this environment, and this crate deliberately does not fetch either automatically. Also unverified: the false-positive rate of the 0.95 similarity threshold specifically for this model's embedding space -- BGE's own docs note its unrelated-text similarity baseline sits well above zero, so this is a real open question, not a formality.
